Career Autofill — Privacy Policy

Effective November 7, 2026 · Applies to the Career Autofill Microsoft Edge extension.

Career Autofill helps users review and fill job-application forms using a professional profile they maintain. It is designed to operate locally in the browser. It does not submit applications or send profile data to the developer.

Information you may choose to store

You may enter or import contact information, education, employment history, job descriptions, references, reusable application answers, and optional demographic or work-authorization responses. These are provided by you and may include personal information. You can choose which fields to fill and whether to overwrite existing form values.

How data is used

The extension reads the active webpage's form labels and currently visible field values when you invoke it. It uses that information locally to propose field mappings, show a preview, and—only after your approval—insert selected answers into the webpage. It does not click an employer's submit button, bypass verification steps, or silently agree to terms. Sensitive demographic and legal answers require separate review.

Where information is stored

Your saved profile is encrypted using a passphrase and stored in your local Microsoft Edge extension storage. The developer does not operate a backend service for your profile. The extension code does not transmit your profile to the developer, analytics services, or advertising services. The extension has no persistent job-site host permission; access to an active page is user-initiated.

When you choose to fill an employer's form, the entered answers become part of that webpage. The employer's website may process or transmit form values under its own privacy policy, particularly when you save or submit your application. Career Autofill cannot control the employer's processing or storage practices.

Backups, retention, and deletion

You can export an encrypted backup or, if you explicitly choose, a readable JSON copy. You are responsible for keeping such files secure. The extension retains local profile information until you delete the vault, remove the extension and its data, or clear browser extension data. It does not automatically delete backups you saved elsewhere. Because encryption is passphrase-based, lost passphrases may not be recoverable.

Special-category and optional application answers

Some employers ask voluntary questions about demographic categories, disability, veteran status, and work authorization. The extension never guesses these responses. Any values you choose to save remain locally encrypted, and filling them is optional and requires explicit user review. The extension is not an immigration, employment-law, or legal-advice service.

Sharing and third parties

Career Autofill does not sell your personal information or share your saved profile with advertisers. It does not include trackers or analytics in its source. Data may leave your device only through actions you take, such as entering information into a job application website, exporting a backup, or using a browser service independent of this extension.

Updates and changes

Store-installed versions are updated through Microsoft Edge Add-ons. Microsoft may process extension metadata under its browser-service policies. Material changes to this policy will be reflected on this page.

Contact

For questions about this extension or its privacy practices, contact waseem.placements@gmail.com.
